description:
Get the technical-health summary of a property's latest Site Audit (crawler) run — use this to add a technical signal next to GSC/GA4 reporting. Returns: health_score (0–100, current plus prev and delta vs the immediately preceding crawl), pages_crawled, crawl_date and prev_crawl_date (ISO 8601), issues_by_severity for severities critical | warning | notice (each with issue_types = number of distinct failing checks, pages_affected = sum of affected URLs across those checks where a URL with N issues counts N times, plus prev and delta vs the previous crawl), issues_by_category (the same broken down by audit category/tab e.g. OnPage, Links, International, Robots, Social, Structured Data, Sitemaps — International covers the hreflang / html-lang checks, codes HREFLANG_* and HTML_LANG_*; Structured Data covers schema.org and Google rich-results checks, codes STRUCTURED_DATA_*; Sitemaps covers sitemap file and listed-URL checks, codes SITEMAP_* and PAGE_MISSING_FROM_SITEMAP), and category_scores (the per-area sub-scores onPage, crawlability, indexability, internationalSeo, technical, social, structuredData, sitemaps — structuredData and sitemaps are null on crawls that predate those categories). NOTE: severity "critical" corresponds to the audit's "error" level. Defaults to the most-recently-finished audit; pass the auditId argument (an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects) to target a specific one. Returns no_crawl_data when the property has no completed crawl. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Technical-health summary of the property's latest site audit crawl.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: get_site_audit_summary
title: Site Audit summary
